title: Absolute value in .uir
starter:
%x = param 0 dtype=i32
# compute |x| using cmplt, where, and mul
%out = add %x 0
hints: |x| is x when x is non-negative and -x when it's negative. Which op picks between two values?
Compute `%neg = cmplt %x 0` and `-x` as `mul %x -1`, then choose with `where`.
What is `-INT_MIN` in i32? `mul` wraps, so it is `INT_MIN` again. The tests expect exactly that.
explain: `where` picks `-x` exactly when `x < 0`. Negation is written as `mul %x -1` because there is no subtract op, and since i32 multiplication wraps, `|INT_MIN|` comes out as `INT_MIN`, which is what a 32-bit machine does.
